entities.summary: Jacob Tanner Diekman is an American former professional baseball pitcher and current coach. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Philadelphia Phillies, Texas Rangers, Arizona Diamondbacks, Kansas City Royals, Oakland Athletics, Boston Red Sox, Chicago White Sox, Tampa Bay Rays, and New York Mets.
